title: Fortresses
line: A position the stronger side cannot break.

steps.text: A queen usually beats a rook. Here the pawn guards the rook, the king hides behind, and the white king cannot cross the rook's row.
Tap the black piece that holds this fortress together.

wrong.g8: The king hides behind the wall. It does not hold the rook.
wrong.f6: The rook is the wall, but something must guard it.

steps.after: The pawn guards the rook. Keep it there and the wall stands.

steps.text: You have Black. Keep the wall: move your king behind it, or slide the rook to the other square the pawn guards.
